result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred position because Vendor may still assign to a financially responsible affiliate without Customer consent, and there is no absolute prohibition on assignment to a Customer competitor. It also does not precisely implement the fallback, which permits both parties to assign to successors on notice but requires consent for other assignments. The edits are otherwise limited and preserve the clause’s general intent, though the placement of the notice condition is somewhat ambiguous as to whether it applies to affiliate assignments as well as Client successor assignments.
